title: 2018 HMMT February Guts Problem 7
statement: A triple of integers \((a, b, c)\) satisfies \(a+b c=2017\) and \(b+c a=8\). Find all possible values of \(c\).

solutions.text:
Answer: \(\quad-6,0,2,8\)
Add and subtract the two equations to find

\[\begin{aligned}
& (b+a)(c+1)=8+2017 \\
& (b-a)(c-1)=2017-8
\end{aligned}\]

We see that \(c\) is even and then that every integer \(c\) with \(c+1|2025, c-1| 2009\) works. We factor and solve.

The full solutions are \((2017,8,0),(-667,1342,2),(-59,-346,-6),(-31,256,8)\).
